contexts.text: Early () = the light of confirmation from celestial good.
To arise early in the morning () = to perceive clearly.
Like clouds... in the early morning time...
Under Morning, see this reference, and at AC 4214. AC 9387. AC 10200.
Joseph came to them in the early morning () = that which is revealed and clear to the Celestial of the Spiritual. The reason why morning, or early morning, has this signification. Explained.
It came to pass in the early morning () = in that new state... Early morning, or morning = a state of enlightenment.

Go to Pharaoh in the early morning () = elevation to things more confirmatory... The morning, or the early morning = a state of enlightenment and of revelation; here, of elevation, because it is predicated of those who are in falsities, who cannot be enlightened, but can have their attention elevated. AC 7435.
Concerning the revelation, they said that it takes place in the early morning time between sleeping and waking.
I will give him the morning star () = intelligence and wisdom then. AE 179.
The reason the star is called morning, is that morning, or morning-mane = the Advent of the Lord, when there is a New Church. Illustrated. AR 954:end.
I am the bright and morning star () = that the Lord was then the Light, and that He will come with new light, which will arise before His New Church, which is the Holy Jerusalem.
